disclaimer: City/local income tax only, single filer, simplified. Only New York City is modeled here. Yonkers is NOT included because its resident tax is calculated as a percentage of NY State tax (16.75%) rather than its own income brackets, which this engine does not yet support — that needs the same 'multiplier-on-tax' mechanism Switzerland's cantonal/communal system would require, not the bracket-based engine used everywhere else in this calculator.

cities.name: New York City
cities.notes: 2024, single filer. NYC resident personal income tax, unchanged since 2017. Applies on top of both Federal and NY State tax.
